events.title: Ubud Village Jazz Festival 2027
events.summary: Festival organizers announced that Ubud Village Jazz Festival will return to STHALA Ubud Bali on 6–7 August 2027. The annual Bali jazz festival brings Indonesian and international musicians together across multiple stages.
